name: Drawer
description: A framework-free Web Component that slides a panel in from an edge, taking its focus trap, Escape key, and backdrop from a native dialog, and behaving as a plain panel when the author writes one.

variants.name: Default
variants.description: A modal navigation panel built on a dialog, with the focus trap and backdrop supplied by the browser.

variants.name: Anchor
variants.description: Panels arriving from each of the four edges, the horizontal pair named by logical direction.

variants.name: Inline
variants.description: A persistent panel that pushes the content beside it and takes none of the modal behaviour.

variants.name: Responsive
variants.description: A permanent panel on a wide screen and a modal one on a narrow screen, without either element pretending to be the other.

variants.name: Scrolling
variants.description: A long panel with a fixed header and footer, over a page whose own scrolling is held still.

variants.name: Dismissal
variants.description: Every way out reported by name, beside a panel that ignores the backdrop because it needs an answer.
